camel_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost ListDatabases --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 20 --DatabaseType MySQL --HostGroupId 20 --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-7mz28f5tk0o' --PageNumber 1 --ProjectId 1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Source Local --NetworkDomainId 2
description_en: Queries the databases that are managed by a bastion host
description_zh: 查询指定堡垒机实例下的数据库列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-databases --instance-id bastionhost-cn-7mz28f5tk0o --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --database-type MySQL --network-domain-id 2 --source Local --host-group-id 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDatabases

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host to query.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的堡垒机所在的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.
Valid values: 1 to100. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page.

We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The engine of the database to query. Valid values:

MySQL

Oracle

PostgreSQL

SQLServer
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的数据库类型，取值：

MySQL
Oracle
PostgreSQL
SQLServer
parameters.name: database_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network domain where the database to query resides
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的数据库所属的网络域ID
parameters.name: network_domain_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the database to query. Valid values:

Local: on-premises database.

Rds: ApsaraDB for RDS instance.

PolarDB: PolarDB cluster
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询数据库的来源。取值：

Local：本地数据库实例
Rds：RDS类型数据库实例
PolarDB: PolarDB类型数据库实例
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asset group to query. This operation returns the databases in the asset group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201307.html operation to query the ID of the asset group
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的资产组ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201307.html接口获取该参数
